comment: Dedicated game servers the server runs alongside itself: copy to gamespy-sessions.json beside the database and edit (docs/gamespy-server.md, 'Sessions'). This machine has no GPU: dedicated-host.sh (installed in the server's bin folder) runs a headless PSPC without a renderer and hosts a Conquest game (server/deploy/swss/README.md, section 3). Each needs a GameSpy account, made from 'accounts', and the folder DEDICATED with its xdg-config (an infrastructure.json that sends *.gamespy.com to 127.0.0.1, so that it does not go through the tunnel), xdg-data (the firmware), xdg-cache and ms0. The paths here are an example: the pspc binary, the disc and the folder are yours.
